claims.exact_statement: Let f be a nonconstant genuine Boolean function, R=H(f)/I(f), D_R(g)=R I(g)-H(g) for physical descendants, and s_R(g,i)=Delta_i H(g)-R I_i(g). For every finite physical restriction tree T rooted at f, with reach weights w_v, sum over leaves w_l D_R(f_l) equals sum over internal nodes w_v s_R(f_v,i(v)). If f is descendant-critical, this sum is nonnegative. At any node with D_R=0 each local slack is nonnegative, with equality exactly when all nonconstant children retain ratio R. For a tree continued to constants the total signed slack is exactly zero.
claims.quantifiers: All finite uniform Boolean cubes, every nonconstant genuine Boolean root, and every finite physical restriction tree with arbitrary stopping leaves.
claims.units: Entropy in bits; reach weights are fair physical restriction probabilities.
hypotheses: fixed root ratio R throughout the tree
descendant-criticality only for nonnegativity and plateau conclusions
proof_dependencies: definitions of Fourier entropy and total influence
scope_exclusions: not a dimension-independent bound on R
does not identify s_R with the B05-B19 L+Q credit
does not make every internal slack nonnegative
does not prove a universal stopping rule or terminal payment
refutes: Descendant-criticality makes every descendant local slack nonnegative.
Positive root slack can be accumulated down a complete tree without signed cancellation.
claims.first_unproved_line: Construct a noncircular compensated stopping rule, or prove a bounded coordinate step, for every descendant-critical tensor-prime Boolean source.
